points.why: Gives explicit triggers for spreadsheet, Vensim and Python/PySD, notes six stocks needs a reason to move, and warns against escalating because it feels more rigorous.
Requires reproducing the spreadsheet in Vensim and Vensim in PySD on identical inputs, stock by stock to a stated tolerance, before trusting it.
Calls time step the most common source of mismatches and requires matching the time step and integration method (Euler).
